title: Collagen Meniscus Implant
revision_history: <p>    05/2010 - Upon completion of a national coverage analysis for the collagen meniscus implant, the decision was made that the collagen meniscus implant is non-covered for Medicare beneficiaries. Effective date: 05/25/2010 <a href="https://www.cms.gov/Regulations-and-Guidance/Guidance/Transmittals/Downloads/R121NCD.pdf">TN 121</a></p>
